header: This is the second tab of the electric-car window, "EV specifications explained": six distinct, colour-coded sections (the two numbers, power, the battery, the Blade battery, AC and DC charging, the socket) that say what each word of a spec sheet means in plain words, then one worked example with the figures worked out from the same arithmetic as the charging-time tab. The text is in evGuideData.ts. Nothing is fetched, stored or sent.
